description.en: The IP address of the client.

description.zh:
需要挂载的用户数据文件的目录列表。必须是全路径，不支持'/../'，取值示例： ["/data/app01", "/data/user"]。
注意：输入的目录路径是虚拟设备"/data"目录的相对目录，即实际对应的虚拟设备路径为"/data/{输入路径}"
description.en: The directory to which the data file is mounted. The value must be a full path and cannot be '/../'. Example: \["/data/app01", "/data/user"]. Specify the relative path of the virtual device for this parameter. For example, specify /data for this parameter when the actual path of the virtual device is /data/{input path}.
The parameter does not take effect.

description.zh: 锁定空闲设备的时间上限，单位秒，仅ServiceAction=PreSchedule有效。默认300。
description.en: The maximum duration for locking an idle device. Unit: seconds. This parameter takes effect only if you set ServiceAction to PreSchedule. Default value: 300.

description.zh: 设备调度策略。Json格式的字符串。
description.en: The scheduling policy of the device. The value must be a JSON string.

description.zh:
调度服务操作。枚举类型，取值范围：

容器化场景：

- Start：选择并激活一个可调度云设备，启动服务
- Stop：结束并释放云设备
- Console：Uuid处于调度中状态时，进行命令交互

裸金属/虚机场景：
  
- PreSchedule：预调度并锁定虚机实例
- Confirm：确认调度
- Cancel：取消调度
- Console：Uuid处于调度中状态时，进行命令交互
description.en:
The scheduling operation. The value must be of the enumeration type. Valid values:

Container scenario:

- Start: selects and activates an idle cloud device.

- Stop: stops and releases the cloud device.

- Console: performs the scheduling operation when the device is in the scheduling state.

Bare metal instance or virtual machine scenario:

- PreSchedule: locks a virtual machine instance for scheduling.

- Confirm: confirms the scheduling operation.

- Cancel: cancels the scheduling operation.

- Console: performs the scheduling operation when the device is in the scheduling state.

description.zh: 容器服务命令列表。Json数组格式的字符串。
description.en: The service commands. The value must be a JSON string.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens run-service-schedule --app-id 474bdef0-d149-4695-abfb-52912d9143f0 --uuid hdm_d4f1059a8e1afc0956bd71b497faa433 --client-ip 180.166.45.146 --service-action Start --pod-config-name android --pre-locked-timeout 300 --directorys /data/app01_,_/data/user --service-commands containerName_:_android_,_commands_:_cat_/tmp/token.json_,_commands_:_ls_-l_/data/data --schedule-strategy selectLevel_:_RegionId_,_values_:_cn-chengdu-telecom-2 --region cn-hangzhou
